email_subject: Application - Hands-on Marketing Manager at EEVEE Mobility
email_body:
Dear EEVEE Mobility team,

I'm applying for the Hands-on Marketing Manager role. Your mission to electrify Europe's corporate fleets resonates with me, and I'd love to bring my digital marketing skills to your commercial team.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for clients. I also run mirook.com, where I've implemented structured data, entity optimization, and technical audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I'm comfortable with social media coordination, performance reporting, and picking up new tools quickly.

I'm proactive, results-driven, and thrive in fast-changing environments. While my Dutch is currently B1 and improving, I'm fluent in English and eager to strengthen my Dutch in a professional setting. I'm based in Zwijndrecht and happy to work from Diepenbeek at least twice a week.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to EEVEE's growth.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear EEVEE Mobility team,

I'm excited to apply for the Hands-on Marketing Manager position. Your mission to accelerate the green transition of Europe's corporate vehicle fleet speaks to me, and I'd be proud to support your commercial organisation with hands-on marketing execution.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that grows organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads. This has taught me to translate strategic goals into actionable content calendars and campaigns, and to optimise based on data.

On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. This project sharpened my ability to manage multiple workstreams, meet deadlines, and stay curious about emerging tools.

I'm proactive, results-driven, and a team player who challenges the status quo. I thrive in fast-changing environments and enjoy setting priorities across projects. My Dutch is currently B1 and I'm taking classes to improve; I'm fluent in English and confident I can contribute effectively while growing my Dutch in a professional context. I'm based in Zwijndrecht and happy to work from Diepenbeek at least two days a week.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can support EEVEE's growth.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
